name: Purchase request approval
documentation: Generic purchase request approval process, written to exercise the notation rather than to describe any one company. Descriptive conformance sub-class of OMG BPMN 2.0.

pools.name: Requester
pools.documentation: Black box pool: the requester is outside the scope of this model, so only the messages exchanged with the company are shown.

nodes.name: Purchase request received
nodes.documentation: The process starts when a request arrives from the requester.

nodes.name: Register purchase request
nodes.documentation: The request is recorded with a reference number.

nodes.name: Check request against purchasing policy
nodes.documentation: Category, quantity and preferred supplier are checked against the written policy.

nodes.name: Collect supplier quotes
nodes.documentation: At least one quote is collected, more when the policy asks for a comparison.

nodes.name: Prepare purchase order
nodes.documentation: The purchase order is drafted from the chosen quote.

nodes.name: Order value above the approval limit?
nodes.documentation: The single decision point of the process.

nodes.name: Send purchase order to the supplier
nodes.documentation: Path taken when the order stays within the limit that purchasing may approve on its own.

nodes.name: Order placed
nodes.documentation: End of the path that needs no financial approval.

nodes.name: Check budget availability
nodes.documentation: Finance confirms that the cost centre still holds the amount.

nodes.name: Record the approval decision
nodes.documentation: The decision and its reason are written on the request.

nodes.name: Inform the requester of the decision
nodes.documentation: The requester is told what was decided and what happens next.

nodes.name: Decision communicated
nodes.documentation: End of the path that goes through financial approval.

nodes.name: Purchase order
nodes.documentation: The document produced by the drafting task and carried through the rest of the process.

nodes.text: The approval limit is set in the purchasing policy and reviewed once a year.

messageFlows.name: Purchase request
messageFlows.documentation: The request form sent by the requester.

messageFlows.name: Approval decision
messageFlows.documentation: The answer returned to the requester.
